recent_excerpts: CISA added CVE-2026-76504, a 9.8-CVSS auth bypass in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager, to its KEV catalog after reports of active exploitation.
CVE-2026-86473 (CVSS 9.1) lets Apache Airflow's Core API logout silently fail for bearer-header clients, leaving stolen tokens valid until expiry.
CISA added CVE-2026-65400, a 9.8-CVSS macOS authentication bypass, to its KEV catalog on August 18, confirming active exploitation. No patch yet.
